usedFor: Recall.ai records meetings, and Dropbox stores files. A “New Recording Becomes Ready” in Recall.ai can run “Upload File to Dropbox” to keep a copy of the recording in a chosen folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recording Becomes Ready” in Recall.ai, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: The trigger fires once the recording's media is available, which is what an upload needs. “New Transcript Completed” covers the text side instead.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” pulls from a public web link, so the recording must be reachable at one. “New Recording Becomes Ready” is polling, with a lookback window in minutes you can set.
